mapper.select: SELECT C.NICKNAME AS nickname, R.RANK_NAME AS rankname FROM COACH C LEFT JOIN RANK R ON NVL(C.POINT_SCORE, 0) >= R.MIN_SCORE AND (R.MAX_SCORE IS NULL OR NVL(C.POINT_SCORE, 0) < R.MAX_SCORE) WHERE C.USER_IDX = #{user_idx}
SELECT reason_type_idx AS reason_type_idx, type_name AS type_name, content AS content FROM reason_type WHERE type_name = '탈퇴' ORDER BY reason_type_idx
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reason_log ( reason_log_idx, user_idx, reason_type_idx, created_at ) VALUES ( SEQ_REASON_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{user_idx}, #{reason_type_idx}, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE coach SET nickname = #{nickname}, mail = #{mail}, phone = NULL, intro = NULL, photo = NULL, video = NULL, kakao_key = NULL WHERE user_idx = #{user_idx}
UPDATE company SET phone = #{phone}, address = #{address}, company_num = NULL, email = NULL, intro = NULL, photo = NULL, kakao_key = NULL WHERE user_idx = #{user_idx}
